t: A retired activity where groups build and program LEGO sumobots to push rivals from a ring.
steps: Find the Sumobot Challenge activity on TeachEngineering or an archive.
Gather LEGO MINDSTORMS NXT or EV3 kits.
Mark a ring on the floor with black tape.
Let groups sketch, build, and program a robot.
Run the ring competition and give the post quiz.
